turns.text: Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I have twenty minutes, Mr. Hale. You gave my son a zero. On what basis?
I'm sorry? I left a client for this. Can we stay on Owen.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: nothing.
What she never said: in October she saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop at 1 AM and never asked; the late-night times came close to that night; it proves nothing, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: bring one piece of evidence she can check herself.
